report: User reports that applying DCP produces a game that does not load; requests Flycast testing.
reporter_details_pending: Selected output file and accompanying tracks
observations: Public full DCP hash matches GitHub release asset metadata.
Isolated profiles preserve the user's normal emulator configuration and VMU saves.
With UseReios=yes, both images load the exact 0.7.50 font kernel, Native font payload and complete English names component into emulated RAM.
The runtime probe does not establish a successful title-screen boot or gameplay; no scenario member was loaded at sampling.
Desktop interaction failed with GetCursorPos access denied. Later window captures returned black for both test and control; these are inconclusive visual evidence.
Initial real-BIOS tests did not identify the loaded game kernel. This is not sufficient to diagnose BIOS or image failure under the inaccessible desktop.
Only the two isolated test processes were stopped after evidence collection. No game payloads or published assets changed.

Follow-up: the project owner tested the suggested DCP-rebuilt image and reports it works. In the resumed session the isolated Flycast window visibly rendered the opening movie; keyboard navigation remained denied by Windows.
conclusion: Project owner reports the DCP-rebuilt image works, and local Flycast visibly renders its opening movie. The original reporter's failure has not been reproduced or explained; full local gameplay navigation remains unverified.
next: Obtain the original reporter's exact image/settings if the no-load claim persists; handle the newly reported UI defects separately.
